title: Water-balance closure
unconfined_help: The saturated thickness depends on head. Changing the aquifer restarts at the selected initial head.
mode_help: Changing the activity restarts at the selected initial head.
tolerance_help: Picard head closure is met when the absolute change between two successive heads is at most this value. Changing the tolerance rechecks the current step.
geometry: Cell centres are 100 m apart. Model width is 1 m. Recharge, evapotranspiration and storage change are zero.
unconfined_geometry: Unconfined aquifer · base at 0 m, top at 5 m. Saturated thickness follows the water table.
confined_geometry: Confined aquifer · base at −2 m, top at 0 m. Saturated thickness is 2 m.
balance_instruction: Adjust the trial head until the face flows match, or apply one Newton correction.
picard_instruction: Compute one update and compare the new head with the previous estimate.
update: Update with the next iteration step
initial: Initial estimate · compute the first update
plot_alt: Three-cell cross-section. Middle-cell head {head} m. Prescribed heads are 4 m on the left and 1 m on the right.
plot_caption: z is elevation. zₜ and zᵦ mark the cell top and base. Vertical scale is exaggerated. In confined flow, the cased observation wells show the hydraulic head.
head_caption: Dashed mark = previous head. Head closure requires |Δh| ≤ {tolerance} m. Computations retain full precision.
budget_caption: Arrows compare the face discharges. Signed discrepancy = 100 × (inflow − outflow) / mean flow. Closure requires |discrepancy| ≤ {tolerance}%.
last_update: Values used for the displayed update
first_compute: Compute the first update to inspect its numerical values.
newton_damping: This step uses α = {fraction}. The correction was reduced to stay between the boundary heads and decrease the residual magnitude.
footer: Developed by Dr.-Ing. Thomas Reimann for TU Dresden and The Groundwater Project. English is the original language.
